additional_info.body:
Hello,
The charger is indeed blocked due to the emergency stop button, which is triggered very regularly.
We have called the client several times to request the reactivation of the charger. And with each charging attempt, some users press the emergency stop button again. There must certainly be a problem that drives them to do so.
Could you analyze what happens just before the emergency stop is triggered or see if the charger has any issues?
With best regards,
